races.paceDynamic: Independent Jimmy will lead unchallenged with Quickasican and Ironica De Thaix providing distant company in the early stages. The pace will be genuine but sustainable given the trip and Independent Jimmy's proven ability to dictate without pressure. The large field of hold-up horses (King Of The Story, Universal Secret, Jiair Madrik, Beep Beep Becky, Sawpit Samantha, Annie Nail, Rockvale) will be forced to race in a pack behind the leaders. This race shape strongly favours the front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and establish good jumping rhythm.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Dominate Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Jimmy maintains sustainable gallop and jumping fluency
scenarios.body: The front three establish unassailable advantage as the field of hold-up horses gets into trouble behind. Independent Jimmy and Quickasican capitalize on their tactical advantage while the hold-up brigade struggle to make ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final mile allowing closers to strike
scenarios.body: King Of The Story and Universal Secret find clear runs to mount telling challenges from the rear. Their superior RPR figures translate into race-winning finishing kicks despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ironica De Thaix avoids her finishing fade and King Of Cong gets forward positioning
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced horses find the perfect balance between avoiding early pace pressure and staying out of trouble. They strike between the tiring leaders and still-traveling hold-up horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a cavalry charge with multiple fallers or interference
scenarios.body: Annie Nail or Rockvale benefit from a messy race where class takes second place to luck in running. The lightweight advantages and proven stamina of these outsiders prove decisive in a war of attrition.

watchPoints.text: Independent Jimmy must handle the extended break and prove fitness after 169 days off

races.paceDynamic: Final Surprise will lead from the start without pressure, setting a steady tempo with no other confirmed front runners in this field. Solo Eclipse, Double Tiger, Beau Quali and The Hostage will create congestion in prominent positions behind the leader, with potential traffic problems developing from the third-last hurdle onwards. The field splits between four prominent runners and five hold-up horses, creating a clear tactical divide. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and benefit from the sustainable pace set by Final Surprise.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Final Surprise sets a steady gallop and the prominent quartet gets congested approaching the business end
scenarios.body: The even pace allows closers to build momentum while traffic problems hamper the prominent runners. Hold-up specialists can pick their way through and time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner breaks clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the four prominent runners (Beau Quali, Double Tiger, Solo Eclipse, The Hostage) manages to avoid traffic and kick clear
scenarios.body: The superior class and race fitness of the prominent position allows them to exploit the sustainable pace and pull away from the closers. Traffic victims struggle but the winner escapes the carnage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Final Surprise wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader's recent win gives him confidence to repel all challengers and no serious pace pressure develops
scenarios.body: The front runner benefits from the uncontested lead and has enough left to hold off late challenges. His proven ability at the trip on good ground makes him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Final Surprise goes too slow early and the prominent quartet fails to organise a proper challenge
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace means stamina becomes less important and the race becomes a sprint finish. This can bring unexpected winners into play from any position.

races.paceDynamic: Barry Fife will set a genuine gallop from the front with little pressure, as the field lacks committed early pace. Crack Ops and Country Mouse will sit handy but neither will challenge for the lead early. The sustained tempo will suit horses who can travel kindly in behind before producing their effort, rather than those needing a sprint finish. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike turning for home, as the lone leader Barry Fife will be vulnerable to challengers with cover.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Barry Fife maintains a steady gallop without folding
scenarios.body: The even pace allows the classier horses to close effectively in the straight. Crack Ops and Galway Reel can use their superior ratings to reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Barry Fife finds another gear turning for home
scenarios.body: The front runner uses his fitness edge and proven course form to stretch the field. Those held up too far back struggle to bridge the gap on this sharp track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with multiple position changes
scenarios.body: The race becomes scrappy allowing hold-up horses to get competitive. Galway Reel's class tells under Sean Bowen's patient riding despite his long absence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Barry Fife goes too slow and multiple horses challenge early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint where fitness and recent form matter most. The fresher horses with less time off can quickest in a dash to the line.

races.paceDynamic: Skyjack Hijack will dictate terms from the front without serious early pressure, as all other runners prefer to hold up or track the pace. The lone leader's sustainable gallop will create a solid tempo through the first circuit before the field closes up turning for home. With seven hold-up horses needing to find gaps and time their runs, the tactical advantage lies with those who can position themselves prominently early or have the tactical speed to strike decisively. This pace setup clearly favours horses with prominent/tracking tendencies who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the pure hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Skyjack Hijack maintains his jumping rhythm and isn't headed too early in the straight
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can exploit his uncontested lead by dictating ideal fractions and having first run on the field when challenged. His two recent wins from the front at this distance prove he can sustain the gallop when allowed to control the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches turning for home and several hold-up horses get hampered or short of room
scenarios.body: The seven closers will create a bottleneck as they all look for racing room simultaneously in the straight. Those with the best turn of foot like Secret Trix or cleanest passage can capitalize when others are stopped in their tracks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Geezer Rockstar or another prominent runner shadows Skyjack Hijack and times their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The prominent horse can benefit from an ideal stalking trip behind the leader before producing a telling burst. This tactical position avoids both the loneliness of leading and the traffic of coming from behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing and Skyjack Hijack weakens, allowing a strong stayer to dominate late
scenarios.body: The extended trip and good ground will suit a horse with stamina reserves who can grind past tired leaders. Super Survivor's recent winning form suggests he retains the ability to finish strongly at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Orderoftheday will control proceedings from the front with minimal early pressure, as the other four runners all prefer to be held up or track the pace. That's Nice may track in second early but won't hassle the leader, while Queensbury Boy, Black Hawk Eagle and Stanners Glen will all be positioned towards the rear waiting to mount late challenges. This creates a tactical race where the front-runner can dictate terms before the hold-up horses unleash their finishing kicks from the back of the field. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained late runs, as they'll get the ideal platform to showcase their closing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Orderoftheday sets steady fractions allowing closers optimal positioning
scenarios.body: The pace will be perfect for the three hold-up specialists to time their runs and sweep past a tiring leader. Queensbury Boy and Stanners Glen both have strong recent form and will relish this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Orderoftheday gets soft sectionals and kicks clear before closers respond
scenarios.body: The leader will have enough left in the tank to resist late challenges on ground that should suit. His style advantage becomes decisive when the chasers leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If That's Nice positions perfectly in second and times his move to perfection
scenarios.body: The Henderson runner can stalk Orderoftheday before launching a well-timed challenge that catches the hold-up horses cold. His prominent style gives him the tactical edge over those starting further back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Orderoftheday goes too slow and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most. Black Hawk Eagle's solid rating and Queensbury Boy's recent win become the decisive factors.

races.paceDynamic: Victoria Milano will dominate early with no genuine competition for the lead, setting a controlled tempo from the front. Behind her, Kingdom Of Stars and Whenthemusicstops will sit in the prominent positions, while the bulk of the field - Nitty Gritty, Good Boy Griff, and Sumatran Tiger - will track from midfield and further back. This creates a straightforward shape where Victoria Milano controls the gallop without pressure, potentially setting up a sustainable pace that could blunt the finishing kick of hold-up horses. This race profile strongly favours front-running and prominent horses who can capitalize on the controlled early tempo and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Victoria Milano Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Victoria Milano maintains her lead and the pace stays honest
scenarios.body: Her uncontested early lead allows her to dictate terms and kick clear when the real racing begins. The sustainable gallop means she retains enough stamina to resist late challenges from tired hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching in the middle stages
scenarios.body: Kingdom Of Stars and Whenthemusicstops benefit from their forward positions while Victoria Milano begins to tire. Their tactical positioning allows them to strike at the optimal moment without getting caught up in traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Finishing Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Victoria Milano sets a genuinely strong pace that stretches the field
scenarios.body: The early pace takes its toll on the front-runners and creates opportunities for the classier hold-up horses. Nitty Gritty and Good Boy Griff benefit from their recent form and ability to finish strongly when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If Victoria Milano goes too slow and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace brings every horse into contention and creates a messy finish full of traffic problems. Fresh horses with tactical speed benefit most while those needing a true test of stamina struggle in the melee.

This creates a tactical setup where the pace-setter gets an easy lead through the early stages before the large pack of hold-up horses mount their challenges from the back. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers, as they avoid the inevitable traffic problems when six hold-up horses try to find racing room simultaneously in the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
